text:
Maria: Quick design check — attaching Figma for the new billing overview. Main ask: make spend + token breakdown usable for org-admins and project-owners in one screen. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/billing-overview (preview)
Jun: Saw it, nice. Question: should the main chart be stacked area (by project) or grouped bars by project? stacked saves space but harder to read small projects.
Olivia: From an accessibility POV stacked areas are tricky for colorblind users and screen readers. If we keep stacked, we need clear legends + patterns and aria labels for each series.
Liz: Backend note — grouped bars would blow up the query if we include model-level token breakout per project for long ranges. We should cap model-breakdown to 30 days or provide async CSV export.
Maria: Good call. Proposal: default month view shows org-level spend + top-5 project breakdown (stacked). Add a toggle to switch to "Project view" where you pick a project and get model/token breakdown and invoice history.
Jun: Toggle sounds nice. For the org view can we show a small table under the chart with currency-normalized spend + avg latency cost per 1k tokens? (helps teams reason about cost)
Olivia: Copy tweak: "Invoices" -> "Billing Statements"? "Invoices" might confuse non-accounting folks. Also add "Download CSV" label with tooltip: "Includes token-level export for selected range".
Maria: I prefer "Billing statements" for clarity. Also want a persistent breadcrumbs: Org > Billing > Project so customers don't get lost when switching views.
design-bot: Accessibility scan: contrast failure on palette #9fb6ff used for small-project series, recommended swap to #6b94ff or add 2px pattern overlay.
Jun: Can we also add an inline mini-legend that shows absolute token counts on hover and has a keyboard-focusable list? Keyboard users need to toggle series visibility.
Olivia: Yes — keyboard focus + Enter toggles series. For screen readers announce "Series visible: X (toggle)" and the current value for the selected date.
Liz: Regarding exports: implement async job for full model-token exports > 30 days. API endpoint: POST /v1/billing/exports with body {range, group_by}. Quick example:
```json
{
  "range": "2025-01-01/2025-03-31",
  "group_by": "project,model",
  "notify": "true"
}
```
Maria: UX for async export: show a toast "Export started" and a row in "Exports" table with status and download link when ready.
Jun: Chart UX: add small sparklines per project in the table to preserve trend context when stacked area is too noisy.
Olivia: Color/accessibility nits: ensure chart has 3 patterns (solid, stripe, dot) when more than 6 series to avoid relying on hue only.
Maria: Final question — default landing for org-admins should be "Org overview" while project-owners land on last-used project view. OK?
Liz: Fine. We'll implement backend limits and async exports first then wire the toggle.
Maria: I'll update the Figma with the toggle states, copy changes, and the exports UX. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Olivia: Leaving a note to check keyboard focus order once implemented :keyboard:
Jun: I'll add the sparklines and the mini-legend interactions in the next PR.
design-bot: Auto-checklist: contrast updated? pending. aria-labels present? pending. export endpoint test? pending.
Maria: Great. Follow-ups: @Olivia please draft the microcopy for the tooltip and export email subject. @Liz please post expected export latency numbers so we can show estimates in UI.
